warning[ZBX-W1203]: lazy start (--lazy) is not possible on this host
  while  running the fuse check of zbx doctor
  cause  /dev/fuse is missing or not openable: zbx run --lazy cannot start
  fix    load the fuse module:   sudo modprobe fuse
         or run without --lazy, which needs no FUSE
  more   zbx explain W1203
  docs   https://zigbox.org/errors/box/W1203.html
